study_identification_part.si4_title: Individual deviations from normative models of brain structure in a large cross-sectional schizophrenia cohort

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Map individual deviations from normative ranges of cortical thickness and fractional anisotropy in schizophrenia, and test whether deviation loci recapitulate group-average pathology maps; assess associations with polygenic risk and symptoms.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Schizophrenia shows widespread group-level FA/CT reductions, yet individual deviation loci are highly heterogeneous; 79% of patients have one or more infra-normal deviations; higher PRS associates with more infra-normal CT regions.
